subject: info-dy
title: INFO.DY.-----WO.EXP.PRI.
description: Diagram opening MP(I)-29 — the section arguing that the twelfth-hour move of activist groups to embrace Marxism shows their lack of fundamental understanding of trans-African philosophical and expansion dictates. The prose below identifies the structural target: 'Marxism — like capitalism — is the affirmation of European and Euro-American methodological perception dynamics, having to do with functional-equal (as opposed to equal-equal), and the net result of this phenomenon is directly in accordance with the western thrust alignment for anti-culture.' The crossing diagrams how information-dynamics structurally meets world-expansion-principle at the western-ideology-adoption scale: INFO-DY (information dynamics — the form's actual information working) crossed with WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle). INFO-DY carries the subject-arrow at upper center, and its main line runs down-left to WO-EXP-PRI. From the main line, ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics) rises at upper-left, with UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)) branching from ACC-DY's line; TR (transformation) branches to the right, with C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism) branching from TR's line and a further unlabeled branch from C-FO-ACT's line; and RE-ST (restructuralism) drops from the main line to the bottom, with POL-DY (political dynamics) and LG-DY (logical dynamics) branching from RE-ST's line and POST (postulation) branching from LG-DY's line.
